entities.summary: Marsel İlhan is a Turkish former professional tennis player. He has a career-high singles ranking of world No. 77 achieved in March 2015. He is the first ever Turkish player to reach the second round in a Grand Slam tournament, as well as the first to win a Challenger event. He is also the first player from Turkey to enter the top 100 in the world rankings.
